text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran the probekit smoke on dev-stg for the new gorgonzola-7b-int8 build. seeing odd mid-generation truncation when prompts include long code blocks. bucketed into two failures out of 50 samples.

alex: can you paste a failing prompt and the model output? also which quant tool + recipe did you use?

maria: failing prompt snippet: '```python\ndef compute(x):\n    # long docstring...\n    return x * 2\n```\nmodel output ends with a partial line and then EOS token, e.g. "return x" then <|endoftext|>. used quantize_v2 --mode=int8-static --calib=2000 (from nightly).

kevin: hmmm might be a tokenization boundary bug — long fenced blocks change token distribution. try forcing `add_bos=False` and `truncate=False` in the probe harness to reproduce. also confirm kv-cache hits vs misses.

sylvie: also cross-check with fp16 baseline on the same dev-stg machine. if fp16 doesn't drop, it's likely quant kernel edge-case. do we have a matching perf trace?

maria: fp16 baseline: no truncation. attached short perf snip: `latency_tokens=1.8ms token_count=320 kv_miss=1` — kv_miss shows occasional cold-cache.

ci-bot: CI: probekit smoke run #2412 completed — 48 passed, 2 failed, logs uploaded to s3://redwood-probes/2412/logs.txt

alex: ok let's do a quick checklist before deeper debugging: 1) reproduce with `--no-cache` and `--force-kv-reset`, 2) run tokenizer diff: `python -m probekit.token_diff --input fail_prompt.txt --model gorgonzola-7b-int8`, 3) run static calibration with 5k samples, 4) compare logits around truncation point (export slice).

maria: starting 1&2 now. will attach token diff.

maria: token diff output: `token_idx 319: "return" -> id 5023, 320: " x" -> id 32, 321: " *" -> id 410, 322: " 2\n```" -> id 9001` — seems contiguous. no split that explains EOS.

kevin: then inspect generation loop logs. paste the generation window around last 20 tokens with logits. also confirm if sampling temperature/topk differ between runs.

maria: generation log snippet: ```
[319] token=5023 logit=3.2 p=0.91
[320] token=32 logit=2.7 p=0.88
[321] token=410 logit=2.1 p=0.83
[322] token=1 logit=-200 EOS triggered
```
looks like EOS logit spikes negative on int8.

sylvie: that's telling — EOS token activation might be corrupted by quant rounding on the final logits. try `--avoid-eos-bias` shim (temporary) and re-run. if it fixes, it's a kernel/quant alignment issue.

alex: good mitigation path. action items: maria to run 5k calibration + avoid-eos-bias shim and report; kevin to reproduce on dedicated machine and run kernel debug; sylvie to open a ticket with quant-team if repro; ops-bot to reserve a short gpu window for dedicated repro.

maria: noted — kicking off calibration job, ETA ~20m. will update thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: reserved slot gpu-dedicated-2 for 30m starting in 10m for "gorgonzola-7b-int8 repro"

maria: quick follow-up — avoid-eos-bias shim eliminated truncation on the sample set. recording as mitigation in the onboarding doc. filing bug: QNT-724.

kevin: great. next steps: (a) add regression test in probekit for fenced-code edgecases, (b) iterate quant recipe to avoid EOS corruption, (c) schedule dedicated replay to produce kernel trace. anyone want to own the probe regression?

alex: i'll own the regression test addition. sylvie, can you own the ticket tracking with quant-team?

sylvie: on it. adding logs and perf traces to QNT-724. linking the probekit PR once alex opens it.

maria: closing loop — updated onboarding checklist: add fenced-code long prompt smoke, token-diff step, `avoid-eos-bias` as temporary knob, and link to QNT-724. tagging this dev-stg bring-up as 'blocking -> quant-fix' for prod rollout.

alex: thanks all, concise plan. :thumbsup:
